capabilities: Replace black and white colors in SVG elements with theme-matching colors
Adapt LaTeX-rendered formula colors for dark mode
Process fill, stroke, color attributes and inline styles
Handle SVGs in regular form and encoded in data-URLs
Mark processed elements to avoid re-processing on updates
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual by copying the plugin folder to .obsidian/plugins/.
problem: SVGs and math formulas rendered with fixed black or white colors become unreadable when the vault uses a dark theme.
summary: SVG color adapter that recolors SVG images and LaTeX-rendered formulas to match the current Obsidian theme background.
